questions.question_text: Write the interval $[3,9)$ as an inequality.

options.why: Swapped the bracket directions: $[$ includes but $)$ excludes.
Treated the round bracket $)$ as if it included $9$.
Used $[$ on $7$, but $>$ is strict, so $7$ is excluded and needs $($.
Used $]$ on $\infty$, but $\infty$ is not a number, so it can never be included.

questions.solution_text:
$7$ is excluded, so use $($; $\infty$ is always excluded, so use $)$.
$(7,\infty)$
